from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single university's enrollment and faculty data needed to compute ratios and groupings."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    total_instructional_faculty: int | None = Field(description="Total number of instructional faculty (Section I-1)")
    total_graduate_students: int | None = Field(description="Total number of graduate students (Section B1)")
    total_all_students: int | None = Field(description="Total number of all students (Section B1)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_records: list[UniversityRecord]
